description: Your Canvas ePortfolios (showcase sites of your work). Read-only; Canvas does not let other apps add entries, so edit them in Canvas itself.

include_deleted.description: If true, also list deleted ePortfolios.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (one page of results). Smaller is faster.

page.description: Which page of results to show, starting at 1. Use it when a result says there are more.
